origins.neoorigins.dwarf.name: Ajenniw
origins.neoorigins.dwarf.description: Ameẓlu azuran n lqaɛa  d aḥerfi, d aḥerfi, yerna ur yeεyi ara deg tẓuri, maca d awezlan yerna d arurad deg tjumma.

Yettunefk-ak-d uqeṛṛu n wuzzal (Unbreaking II, Efficiency I) ticki tferneḍ aɣbalu-agi.
origins.neoorigins.breeze.name: Aḍu

power.neoorigins.breeze_no_fall_damage.d: Yettwakkes: aḍu ad k-id-yeṭṭef mi ara teɣliḍ. Yermed s lexṣas  kkes-it s tsarut n tzemmar akken ad d-tawiḍ inadiyen iweɛren.

power.neoorigins.breeze_jump_boost.descr: Tzemreḍ ad tsenseḍ/tsenseḍ: ifuyla n ubeḥri ad k-rren ad tnegreḍ ugar (Jump Boost II). Rmed s lexṣas  sens s tsarut n tzemmar ma tebɣiḍ ad tnegreḍ s teɣzi tamagnut.
